discovery.title: The Brewers came back from four runs down—again
discovery.summary: Milwaukee beat Tampa Bay 5–4 in World Series Game 2 after trailing 4–0, taking a 2–0 series lead.
discovery.why_it_matters: A comeback can change a championship’s momentum—and make a team’s resilience part of the story.
